name: Japanese Somen Noodles (Ultra-Thin Wheat Noodles in Mild Dashi)
whyItWorks: Crafted from fine white wheat flour and stretched paper-thin. Cooks in just 90 seconds into silken strands that are exceptionally soothing on irritable bowel mucosa.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil somen noodles for 90 seconds. Rinse in cold water to remove starch, then serve warm in mild bonito/kombu dashi with a dash of tamari.
